name: A turn of a few minutes gets a face but leaves the mood alone
case: Two turns of a few minutes each finish well, one with passing tests. Each finish gets a pleased face, held once or twice, played as a success, but nothing bigger, since neither stands out. Boop stays calm, or follows the work (engaged) while it goes on.
why: characters/boop/steering/mood/calm.md: calm stays through routine finishes, even a few minutes long, since only a very long turn (5 minutes or more) finishing done lifts it; it may follow a long turn, engaged, at a check-in; PERSONALITY's Examples: a turn of a minute or more finishing done gets a happy face and its success, small or medium, and the 2nd quick win of a streak a pleased one
